name: Black Shasta
desc:
If this card is in your hand and you control a Normal Monster or a Dinosaur monster: You can Special Summon this card. If this card is destroyed by battle or card effect and sent to the GY: You can equip this card to 1 face-up monster on the field as an Equip Spell with these effects.
● The equipped monster loses 2400 ATK.
● If the equipped monster has 2500 or more original ATK, neither player can activate its effects.
You can only use each effect of "Black Shasta" once per turn.
